sloka: या पुत्रम् ईदृशम् राज्ञः प्रवासयति धार्मिकम् ।वन वासे महा प्राज्ञम् सानुक्रोशम् अतन्द्रितम् ॥२-४९-६॥
transliteration: yā putram īdṛśam rājñaḥ pravāsayati dhārmikam ।vana vāse mahā prājñam sānukrośam atandritam ॥2-49-6॥

translations.english: (The villagers were speaking among themselves) Fie on the king who is overtaken by passion Alas, the heartless, sinful Kaikeyi, indulging in evil has banished into the forest this prince who is righteous and sagacious, compassionate and selfrestrained. How could this cruel Kaikeyi, by breaking all limits of decorum resort to such atrocious action?
translations.hindi: न तो कोई अपने नष्ट हुए धन को पा कर और न कोई विपुल धन पा कर ही हर्षित होता था । अ्येष्ठपुत्र को पा कर माता प्रसन्न न होती थी ॥%॥ गृहे ग्रृहे रुदन्त्यश्च भतार ग्रृहमागतम्‌। ९ (4 NN व्यगहयन्त दुःखाता वागिभिस्तोत्र रिव द्विपान्‌
